label: preparing
what: A concealed welcome/tea setup for the mayor at the neighbour's east-bank cottage, including construction/decorative lanterns and food provisions (bread, with hay blocks supplied for baking). The record supports coordinated preparation, but does not establish the participants' exact private intentions; the later book explicitly confirms a mayoral tea invitation at the cottage, so the preparation is plausibly for that visit. The mayor was not told of this preparation in the visible record; he was told of the tea appointment itself.
